notes: Transport evidence is permitted only when a source record identifies a known L4 carrier. Unknown protocol evidence never authorizes automatic official port mapping. No-protocol logs retain existing source-specific review policy; raw bytes are never discarded. Explicitly labeled source-port/destination-port fields are eligible for owner-requested integer mapping to srcport/dstport after range validation; on ICMP the numeric value may be a vendor identifier, not a transport port. Ambiguous alias names remain subject to protocol evidence. NAT/translated ancestor tokens are blocked across dot, underscore, hyphen and camelCase source path spellings before any explicit port identity approval.
